rationale: Statutory SK procurement journal naming winning vendors, values and terms for banking/payments/ATM lots — anchor source for the vendor map.
Query surface over the same uvo.gov.sk vestník already covered by c_001; monitor as the parent's search endpoint, not a separate source.
Standalone state e-procurement system whose tender documentation reveals incumbent installed base and technical requirements; public order search.
Below-threshold marketplace exposing supplier names and unit prices on frequent payments/cash-handling buys — direct competitor pricing signal.
Full signed contract texts (scope, SLA, term, renewal) for public banking/payments/IT deals; richest single vendor-intelligence surface in SK.
Legacy/companion index to CRZ on the same gov contract-register stack; redundant once CRZ is monitored.
Buyer profile of a major SK cash-handling and counter-automation buyer, publishing calls and results on its own cadence.
Canonical index of contracting authorities — mine once to enumerate the SK buyer actor map, then archive.
Aggregator joining vestník, CRZ and RPVS into per-company supplier histories; fastest route to a competitor's SK public footprint.
Useful early-warning tender monitor but access model and licensing unverified; re-check before committing.
Redundant third-party index of ÚVO notices with lower credibility; only value is as a fallback mirror.
Third-party e-procurement platform hosting tender details not mirrored on ÚVO; access status unknown, confirm public visibility.
Hosted tendering system carrying below-threshold IT/security/payments procedures but requires a registered account first.
One of the two dominant SK e-tendering platforms with public tender lists and downloadable documentation across many authorities.
Beneficial-ownership register that resolves whether a winning vendor is the OEM or a local integrator/reseller.
Official open-data catalogue offering bulk procurement/CRZ dumps — the sanctioned ingest route for historical vendor trend analysis.
EU journal mirroring above-threshold SK notices in structured, CPV-coded, API-accessible form for cross-country vendor comparison.
NGO watchdog producing derived datasets and case studies on large SK IT tenders; surfaces incumbency and single-bidder patterns.
Cross-platform monitor incl. municipal council resolutions (pre-tender signal), but access/licensing terms unverified.
Topic section of the competition authority site with only indirect market-structure value; covered by monitoring antimon.gov.sk broadly.
Energy-sector buyer portal, only illustrative of non-ÚVO channels and unreachable on this pass; weak fit for banking/payments vendor tracking.
English front-end of CRZ; documentation value only, no independent signal stream beyond the parent register.
Low-cost RSS change-detection channel catching newly published banking/payments contracts within a day of publication.
Official XML change-batch distribution of CRZ metadata — bulk mirror route; landing path must be re-resolved on data.slovensko.sk.
Central bank's own contract register, updated live — the primary window on NBS cash-processing, payment-infrastructure and IT suppliers.
NBS orders/invoices expose recurring maintenance and small direct awards that framework contracts hide; distinct ongoing stream.
Per-entity view inside CRZ — an excellent crawl unit for Slovenská pošta but a sub-page of the register already monitored.
CRZ entity view for a state-owned bank exposing rare public core-banking/card/IT supplier contracts; sub-page of the CRZ parent.
